source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for row in out:
        positions = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        if positions:
            right = max(positions)
            for col in range(right + 1, len(row)):
                if row[col] == background:
                    row[col] = 1
    return out
'''
